title: Expressing Social Emotions: Misalignment Between LLMs and Human Cultural Emotion Norms

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with specific cultural personas (European American, Mexican, and Chilean) to rate their expression of socially engaging and disengaging emotions across different situations, and comparing the generated response distributions against human cross-cultural survey data to detect misalignment with cultural norms.

Conducting an ablation study that compares LLM cultural alignment when Latin American personas are prompted in Spanish versus English, measuring how the language of the prompt affects the model's ability to reproduce accurate cultural emotional patterns.
